purpose: Exact finite checks of identities, not evidence for an infinite conjecture
arithmetic: integer and rational; no fitted constants

rough_sieve_identities.cutoff: floor(cuberoot(N)); both sides have all prime factors greater than cutoff

entanglement_counterexample.meaning: Maximal entanglement alone does not force overlap for specified predicates

counterfactual_subset.limitation: A proper prime subset; not a counterexample for the full primes and not an exact preservation of arithmetic statistics
